project: Marrow v1 — Closure-Grade Invariants for Natural Rows
milestone_sealed: M0 (I0 census + power record). M1–M5 are NOT sealed here — Kill 1 fires.
committed_before_analysis: the census's ADMISSION RULES were fixed before the count was read; the count then fired Kill 1. The rules were not adjusted afterwards, and the band of readings is reported rather than the single reading that would have cleared the floor.
supersedes: nothing. Marrow is a new instrument. All prior verdicts, preregs and frozen bytes stand untouched.

anchors_by_hash.note: verified at M0, 2026-07-25. anatomy_v1 is NOT modified by Marrow — see `version_class`.

THE_HEADLINE.terroir_c: CANNOT RUN — declared INSUFFICIENT IN ADVANCE
THE_HEADLINE.consequence: Marrow ships as a CENSUS NOTE, not a build, exactly as the spec's Kill 1 pre-declared. M1–M5 do not run.
THE_HEADLINE.the_finding: the natural atlas is PRESENTATION-POOR at closure grade — itself a statement about where closure anatomy can exist, and the spec named it as a legitimate result before the census ran.

planning_estimate_replaced.note: the strict test removes rows a name-pattern accepts: unbounded-arity domination and set-cover families, colourings with global side constraints (equitable/acyclic/harmonious), quantified variants (choosability, qcsp, tqbf), and ordering CSPs over infinite domains (betweenness, cyclic-ordering). 57 near-misses are excluded with individually stated reasons.

THE_FIXED_TEMPLATE_AMBIGUITY.status: SURFACED BY THE CENSUS. Marrow §1 does not settle it. IT IS AN OWNER RULING, PENDING.
THE_FIXED_TEMPLATE_AMBIGUITY.the_question: is the admission test 'is this row CSP-shaped?' or 'is there a FIXED finite template whose Pol we can compute?'
THE_FIXED_TEMPLATE_AMBIGUITY.why_it_is_load_bearing: polymorphisms are computed OF A TEMPLATE. Where the template is part of the INPUT — H in graph-homomorphism, Gamma in maximum-csp, k in chromatic-number — there is no fixed Gamma and `poly_fingerprint_natural` is UNDEFINED on that row. A computability fact, not a stylistic preference.
THE_FIXED_TEMPLATE_AMBIGUITY.what_the_ruling_changes: KILL 1 ONLY. It does NOT change the Terroir-C verdict, which fires under every reading — see M0b.
THE_FIXED_TEMPLATE_AMBIGUITY.recorded_rather_than_decided: the reading that clears the floor is available and was not taken. Choosing an admission rule after seeing which one clears a kill criterion is the failure this record exists to prevent.

M0b_terroir_c_power.status: DECLARED INSUFFICIENT IN ADVANCE — before any presentation is pinned
M0b_terroir_c_power.screen_inherited: prereg_v14 (n>=30 AND modal<0.90 per family); not re-chosen for this seal

three_independent_blockers.1_zero_admissible_families: under BOTH readings. Principled: sat-csp 15, graph 13, optimization 3, geometric 1, logic-proof 1. As-censused: graph 19, sat-csp 16, rest <=3. No family reaches n=30.
three_independent_blockers.2_stratum_2_is_CONSTANT: the 18 vcsp-shaped rows are 18/18 NPC — modal share EXACTLY 1.000. Not merely starved: CONSTANT, carrying no information at all. Half the presentable population cannot support a decision-charge contrast under any statistic.
three_independent_blockers.3_fold_structure_infeasible: Terroir-C inherits family-grouped 5-fold CV. Only 2 families have >=5 rows (graph, sat-csp), so the fold key cannot produce 5 non-trivial folds.

mde_if_the_screen_were_ignored.note: NOT the sealed statistic — recorded only to show that even discarding the screen the instrument sees +0.12 and up

M0b_terroir_c_power.THE_SEALED_SENTENCE: Terroir-C cannot run as a within-family residual test on this population: every family falls below n=30, so the statistic A4 defined has no admissible stratum to be computed on. DECLARED INSUFFICIENT IN ADVANCE — AND INSUFFICIENT IS NOT EVIDENCE OF ABSENCE. The closure question is not answered here; it is unasked for want of a population.

STRATUM_2_VARIANCE_FLAG.flag: the vcsp-shaped stratum is CONSTANT on `decision`: 18/18 NPC, modal share 1.000
STRATUM_2_VARIANCE_FLAG.strengthened_from_the_planning_figure: the plan carried 90.6% from the regex set; the census's stricter stratum 2 is 100%
STRATUM_2_VARIANCE_FLAG.why_it_is_here_and_not_only_in_the_censu: so that if M1 is ever resumed nobody 'discovers' later that the optimization stratum carries no decision-charge contrast. The artifact-level flag rule, applied at birth.
STRATUM_2_VARIANCE_FLAG.consequence_for_any_resumption: a sealed bet on `decision` may not draw on stratum 2 alone; it would be scoring a constant.

columns_sealed_for_any_resumption.note: sealed even though unbuilt, so a resumption inherits decided questions rather than reopening them

presentation.reason: the column's declared object IS the choice of presentation. Precedent: encoding_type's own passport — 'the column's declared object IS the encoding, so encoding-relativity is not a defect here, it is the column's definition.'

poly_fingerprint_natural.property_of: the constraint language AT THE PINNED PRESENTATION
poly_fingerprint_natural.reason: Boolean `poly_fingerprint` earns `invariant` because on that universe THE RELATION IS THE OBJECT — there is no choice to make. On natural rows a human pins the presentation, which is exactly what `parameter-relative` ('meaningful only against a pinned parameter/ensemble') exists to say. The spec expected `invariant`; that is the arity_class over-claim in a new column.

fractional_poly_facts.reason: VCSP was already ruled NOT BUILDABLE in this repo (foundry/docs/findings/G3-vcsp-buildability.md; echoed in generation-cannot-reach-the-gradient.md) on classification-gap grounds — Thapper-Zivny dichotomizes EXACT solvability only. Reserved rather than reversed. Second reason from the census: stratum 2 is constant on `decision`, so the column could carry no contrast even if built.
fractional_poly_facts.reserving_it_now_is_the_point: a later fill becomes legal under Anatomy-SCHEMA §4's additive licence, which covers reserved names only

pcsp_facts.reason: promise-CSP polymorphisms (BBKO line); zero PCSP code exists in the repo. The census found exactly 1 promise row (robust-csp), so the stratum is real but tiny.

version_class.ruling: NEW SEALED ANATOMY v2 — not an additive v1.1
version_class.why_the_spec_was_wrong: Anatomy-SCHEMA §4 pre-authorizes additive fills for RESERVED NAMES ONLY, and the reserved list is channelness / fo_form / tuple_density / row_relations. None of Marrow's columns are on it. §0.3.3 governs: 'a changed rule is a new sealed version, never an in-place edit.'
version_class.second_reason: adding columns rewrites anatomy_v1.jsonl's bytes, breaking its `tolerance: exact` sha pin in repro/manifest.yaml and tests/test_anatomy.py, against the standing frozen-bytes law.
version_class.consequence: anatomy_v1.jsonl stays frozen at 8ff11f8a FOREVER. Any v2 is a new artifact with its own freeze record, hash, manifest claims and tests — and v1's existing tests passing UNCHANGED is the evidence that v2 is a new artifact rather than an edit.
version_class.no_precedent_existed: no additive extension has ever been executed on this artifact; tuple_density was reserved and never built.

flags_7_to_10_are_n_a_by_theorem.rule: these are Boolean BY THEOREM, not merely by implementation — KSTW and Marx do not transfer to |D|>2. On any non-Boolean row they ship as `n.a.` with reason. NEVER ported, NEVER approximated.
flags_7_to_10_are_n_a_by_theorem.enforced_by: a test asserting the boundary, so it cannot erode silently

derive_engine_type_is_quarantined.hazard: build_anatomy.derive_engine_type computes `fs = bool(flags['affine'])`, encoding the Boolean collapse few-subpowers <=> Maltsev <=> affine. That equivalence BREAKS at k>2 (Maltsev => few subpowers, but few subpowers needs a k-edge term).
derive_engine_type_is_quarantined.rule: it must not be called on non-Boolean rows. domain3.py:207-212 already handles the split correctly and is the pattern to follow.
derive_engine_type_is_quarantined.status: chief correctness risk of the whole build, named before any code is written

anchor_set.already_green_boolean: 3-SAT -> no tractable polymorphism, Horn -> semilattice(MIN), 2-SAT -> majority, XOR -> affine — foundry/tests/test_census.py via oracles.verify_class
anchor_set.genuinely_new_would_be: an explicit majority-at-D3 assertion, and anything at k>=4

spec_defects_logged.defect: §2/§6 call the column family 'Anatomy v1.1, additive'. §4's additive licence covers reserved names only, and none of Marrow's columns are reserved — so by the schema's own §0.3.3 this requires a new sealed version. Logged at owner's direction, one line.

§2 expects `invariant` passports on all shipped columns; `presentation` is encoding-relative by its own definition and the derived columns are parameter-relative to the pin. Corrected before build rather than after, unlike arity_class.
§2 proposes `fractional_poly_facts` without citing this repo's own prior NOT BUILDABLE ruling on VCSP.
the planning estimate of 82 presentable rows came from a regex over problem names and was 2.4x the census. It was labelled an estimate with error bars, but the error was larger than the bars implied.

what_survives_and_what_does_not.does_not: Terroir-C, the retrospective retest. There is no population for it, under any reading. The FAMILY-BORNE verdict's one legitimately-open retrospective question stays open and now has a measured reason why.
what_survives_and_what_does_not.may_survive_by_owner_ruling: the registry upgrade (spec §3.2) does NOT depend on Terroir-C — a prospective predict-then-fill wave carrying closure-feature predictions is confound-free by construction and accumulates regardless of retrospective population size. But it needs the columns, which need M1–M4, which Kill 1 stops. Building them FOR THE REGISTRY ALONE is a live option and an owner decision, not a consequence of this seal.
what_survives_and_what_does_not.stands_unchanged: the prospective registry at 0/57 remains the program's one armed confound-free instrument.
